translation.en: The book is on the table.
The girl read the book.
I found the picture in the book.
The cover of the book is red.
Good spreads quickly.
The man did good.

translation.bs: Otac je pozvao sina na dobro.
translation.en: The father called his son to good.
The path of good is clear.
The disbeliever does not pray.
The preacher invited the disbeliever kindly.
The scholar spoke with the disbeliever.
The disbeliever's heart changed.
The child's guardian attended.
The teacher thanked the student's guardian.
The teacher spoke with the guardians.
The guardian's name is written.
The righteous person loves people.
People love the righteous.
The child sat with the righteous.
The righteous man's house is near.
The women are at the market.
The teacher thanked the women.
The doctor spoke with the women.
The women's market is large.
Creation is the topic of the book.

translation.bs: Pročitao sam knjigu o stvaranju čovjeka.
translation.en: I read a book about the creation of man.
The beginning of creation is the topic of the lesson.
The king's reign is long.
The prince inherited the kingship.
The minister coveted the kingship.
The history of the kingship is long.
The Muslim fasts in Ramadan.
The city welcomed the Muslims.
The man prayed with the Muslims.
The Muslims' holiday is near.
Kindness is not forgotten.
The neighbor did a kindness.

translation.bs: Čovjek se zahvalio komšiji na dobru.
translation.en: The man thanked the neighbor for the kindness.

translation.bs: Oni koji čine dobro su plemeniti.
translation.en: People of kindness are noble.
The brother's share is large.
The worker received the share.
The brother was content with the share.
The value of the share is small.
The harm is large.
The doctor prevented the harm.

translation.bs: Otac je zaštitio sina od štete.
translation.en: The father protected his son from harm.
The effect of the harm is clear.
Desires differ.
The wise man went against the desires.
The judge does not judge by desires.
The pursuit of desires is a danger.
The tribe's custom is old.
The villagers revived an old custom.
The family preserved the custom.
Respect for the custom is important.
The warner raised his voice.
The villagers heard the warner.
The people hurried to the warner.
The warner's voice is strong.
The bones are strong.
The dog ate the bones.
Milk is useful for the bones.
The strength of the bones is important.
The fighting stopped yesterday.
The people rejected the fighting.
The people fled from the fighting.
The end of the fighting is near.
The admonition is useful.
The students heard the admonition.

translation.bs: Mladić je imao koristi od pouke.
translation.en: The young man benefited from the admonition.
The effect of the admonition is great.
The structure is strong.
The tourists visited the structure.
The worker stood on the structure.
The foundation of the structure is firm.
The loudness of speech bothered the neighbors.

translation.bs: Učitelj nije volio glasnoću u biblioteci.
translation.en: The teacher disliked loudness in the library.

translation.bs: Susjedi su se žalili na glasnoću govora.
translation.en: The neighbors complained of the loudness of speech.
The degree of loudness is high.
The trees grow in the garden.
The farmer watered the trees.
The birds live in the trees.
The shade of the trees is beautiful.
Terror spread in the village.
The earthquake caused terror.
The child screamed from terror.
The feeling of terror is difficult.
Ignorance causes problems.
The teacher fought ignorance.
The people were freed from ignorance.
The result of ignorance is clear.
The decoration adorns the wall.
The artist sketched a beautiful decoration.

translation.bs: Stolar je radio na ukrasu dva dana.
translation.en: The carpenter worked on the decoration for two days.
The beauty of the decoration is clear.
Weakness showed on the patient.
The doctor treated the patient's weakness.
Grandfather felt weakness.
The cause of the weakness is lack of sleep.
A group of young men arrived.
I saw the group in the market.
The leader spoke with the group.
The leader of the group is brave.
The tree trunk fell.
The worker cut the trunk.
The friends sat on the trunk.
The shade of the trunk is long.
The preservation of food is important.
The manager requests the preservation of the papers.
The refrigerator is for the preservation of food.
The method of preserving food is easy.
The shelter was warm.
The municipality built the shelter.
The family sat in the shelter.
The door of the shelter is large.
The worshippers entered the mosque.
The imam received the worshippers.
The children distributed water to the worshippers.
The number of the worshippers was large.
The cow's lowing is strong.
The farmer heard the cow's lowing.

translation.bs: Dijete je pitalo o mukanju krave.
translation.en: The child asked about the cow's lowing.
The reason for the lowing is hunger.

translation.bs: Primirje je počelo između dva plemena.
translation.en: The truce began between the two tribes.
The commander accepted the truce.
The two armies agree to the truce.
The stipulations of the truce are clear.
My father's namesake came.

translation.bs: Učenik je sreo imenjaka svog brata.
translation.en: The student met his brother's namesake.

translation.bs: Čovjek je razgovarao s imenjakom svog djeda.
translation.en: The man spoke with his grandfather's namesake.

translation.bs: Posjetili smo kuću imenjaka mog djeda.
translation.en: We visited the house of my grandfather's namesake.
